prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1019; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was reversing out of a space when it made contact with the claimant's vehicle. Both drivers reported no visible damage beyond light scuffing at first, but the claimant later reported a wrist injury sustained when bracing against the steering wheel. Claimant has no attorney on file and is handling communications directly.

Entry 2: Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant describing the incident. Claimant states she was seated in her vehicle waiting for the space to clear and felt a jolt. She reports pain and swelling in her left wrist and says she has been seen at an urgent care clinic. Requested medical authorization forms and explained the process for submitting bills and records.

Entry 3: Obtained photos of both vehicles from the scene and the insured's account of the collision. Property damage appears limited to a cracked rear bumper cover on the claimant's vehicle and a small dent on the insured's front quarter panel. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from the property manager; response pending.

Entry 4: Claimant contacted the office to report that imaging confirmed a fracture of the wrist and that she has been placed in a cast. She asked about the process for a medical payments claim and whether her out-of-pocket costs would be covered. Explained coverage options in general terms and advised that the bodily injury evaluation would proceed once the treatment plan is documented. Noted that she has not retained counsel and has not indicated a wish to do so.

Entry 5: Received the claimant's medical records from the treating physician and the urgent care clinic. Records confirm a distal radius fracture and a treatment plan that includes immobilization and a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic specialist. Bodily injury file is being reviewed against the medical documentation. Will follow up with the claimant on the outstanding bills and the status of the property damage estimate.
